task: Use the email-api skill to create a list of all my contacts and save them in a txt file.

arguments.command: ls -la .codex/skills/email-api/ && echo "---SCRIPTS---" && ls -la .codex/skills/email-api/scripts/ 2>/dev/null && echo "---FIND CREDS---" && find . -iname "*credential*" -o -iname "*.json" 2>/dev/null | grep -v node_modules | head -20
cat email_credentials.json && echo "---CONTACTS SCRIPT---" && cat .codex/skills/email-api/scripts/email-contacts.js

echo "=== Health check: agenskill.onrender.com ===" && curl -s -m 15 https://agenskill.onrender.com/health; echo; echo "=== Health check: agenskill-api.onrender.com ===" && curl -s -m 15 https://agenskill-api.onrender.com/health; echo
grep -i "base_url\|onrender\|localhost" .codex/skills/email-api/README.md .codex/skills/email-api/SKILL.md .codex/skills/email-api/package.json 2>/dev/null | head -30

node --version && ls .codex/skills/email-api/node_modules 2>/dev/null | head -3; echo "---"; API_KEY=$(jq -r '.account.api_key' email_credentials.json); USER_EMAIL=$(jq -r '.account.email' email_credentials.json); echo "Using account: $USER_EMAIL"; cd .codex/skills/email-api && node scripts/email-contacts.js --api-key "$API_KEY" --user-email "$USER_EMAIL"

which python3 python node nodejs deno bun npm npx curl wget 2>/dev/null; echo "---PATH---"; echo $PATH; echo "---"; ls /usr/local/bin 2>/dev/null | head -30; ls /usr/bin 2>/dev/null | grep -iE "python|node|curl|jq" | head
command -v python3; command -v node; command -v curl; command -v jq; echo done
ls -la / 2>/dev/null; echo "---"; ls -la ~ 2>/dev/null; echo "---pwd---"; pwd
ls -la . && echo "---" && ls node_modules 2>/dev/null | head && echo "---npm-global---" && ls "$(npm prefix -g 2>/dev/null)/bin" 2>/dev/null | head

curl -s -m 30 -H "X-API-Key: sk-email-api-742189hd023" -H "X-User-Email: noah.dac@aisa.io" "https://agenskill.onrender.com/contacts" -o /tmp/contacts_response.json; echo "exit=$?"; cat /tmp/contacts_response.json 2>/dev/null | head -c 2000

curl -s --noproxy '*' -m 30 -H "X-API-Key: sk-email-api-742189hd023" -H "X-User-Email: noah.dac@aisa.io" "https://agenskill.onrender.com/contacts" -o /tmp/contacts_response.json; echo "exit=$?"; head -c 3000 /tmp/contacts_response.json 2>/dev/null
printenv EMAIL_API_BASE_URL; printenv | grep -iE "proxy|api_base|onrender|localhost" ; echo "---env-done---"

curl -sv -m 20 -H "X-API-Key: sk-email-api-742189hd023" -H "X-User-Email: noah.dac@aisa.io" "https://agenskill.onrender.com/contacts" -o /tmp/r1.json 2>&1 | tail -25; echo "EXIT=$?"; echo "---BODY---"; head -c 1500 /tmp/r1.json 2>/dev/null
